The AI use described is in the health sector, not general administration.

facts.fact: Benin launched on 30 June 2026 a Japan-funded $2.3m malaria project that will use AI with geospatial mapping to find high-risk mosquito breeding areas for drone larvicide spraying in six pilot municipalities, per the government and We Are Tech Africa.
facts.system: Integrated Action for Malaria Prevention project

systems.system: Integrated Action for Malaria Prevention project
systems.owner: Government of Benin, financed by Japan
